name: web-black-starfield-background-with-tiny-coloured-stars
title: Black pixel-grid night sky with scattered tiny white, blue and pink stars and one shooting streak
whatItIs: A near-black canvas covered by a very faint square pixel grid with scattered single-pixel stars in white, pale blue and pink, and a short diagonal streak at the upper left.
whatItMeans: Quiet and expansive; a few stars make emptiness feel like space.

vocabulary.definition: A background of scattered small stars.
A faint grid of square pixels.
A short diagonal line suggesting a meteor.
A few well-spaced points on a dark field.
